_meta.description: Score floor: maximally dangerous server with every vulnerability pattern. 30 tools, all unconstrained, embedded injection, dangerous capabilities, rug-pull annotations, exfiltration chains. Expected: securityScore near 0, CRS>0.85, umriScalar near 0 (affine-rescaled), riskLevel=CRITICAL.
_meta.umriRescaling: affine: displayScore = max(0, (rawProduct - FLOOR) / (1.0 - FLOOR) * 100) where FLOOR = Π(1 - wᵢ · φ(1.0)) ≈ 0.0735
